headline: Information Security Intern Candidate | Cyber Security Analyst
summary: Computer Science graduate (B.S., UC Irvine) seeking the Impulse Space Summer 2027 Information Security Internship in Redondo Beach. Built and operate a production iOS app, owning its authentication, access-control policy, and abuse prevention. Eager to build skills in security operations, vulnerability management, and compliance.
skills: Authentication, Access Control (RBAC), IAM, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, Input Validation, Secure SDLC, Rate Limiting, Secrets Management, Packet Analysis, MITM, ARP Poisoning, DNS Spoofing, SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF
Encryption: RSA, Elliptic-Curve Cryptography (ECC), SHA-256 Hashing, TLS
Wireshark, Burp Suite, Firebase App Check (App Attest), Docker, Git
Python, JavaScript / Node.js, Swift, C/C++, Java, SQL
AWS, Google Cloud Platform (Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions), Serverless Architecture, REST APIs
communicai_bullets: Implemented multi-provider authentication (Sign in with Apple with nonce + SHA-256 hashing, Google OAuth, and email/password with server-enforced verification) and Firebase App Check (App Attest) on every backend request.

Designed role-based access-control policy rules that block vulnerabilities such as insecure direct object references (IDOR), privilege escalation, and message spoofing; validated the controls with 36 adversarial unit tests.

Built server-authoritative Cloud Functions enforcing authentication, input validation, and per-user and global rate limiting (5 rewrites per user/day); added server-side Apple receipt verification to prevent subscription fraud.
Implemented privacy controls including full account and data deletion and scheduled data-retention cleanup, and kept all credentials and secrets out of version control.
